notes.title: September Update
notes.notes: [p]Hey everybody![/p][p]It’s been a while since we shared our progress, so we are happy to finally give you an update on what we have been working on![/p][p]First of all, I’m proud to show off the current talent tree. We added 10(!) new talents so far, which brings the current total to 19, more than twice the amount of the Demo![/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45599374/9ea78f47fe45f9ed2186c56e2c87e3781c362806.png"][/img][/p][p]I don’t want to spoil them all already, so you can speculate a bit based on the icons. Let’s take a look at only two of the new talents for now.[/p][p][/p][p]The first is one of the most suggested talents from the community, oxidizing copper coins. When you don’t interact with copper coins for a while they start to oxidize and then grant bonus money when you ultimately flip them.[/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45599374/f1218ee7f29d978312591816e42bc7a8548fdf96.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]The second one has been super fun to animate and made me laugh a few times^^[/p][p][b]you vs. the guy she told you not to worry about[/b]:[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45599374/5409f94ccd43ac324ad670c84c21fc7494038680.gif"][/img][/p][p]We have also been sharing some very early work in progress screenshots of a new thief-helper and the table select mechanic on our Discord. If you would like to see stuff early or want to suggest ideas for new talents, we’d love to have you [url="https://discord.gg/qe5FZbpFAE"]join the Gamblers Table Discord[/url]! But we’ll of course also show the new features here once they are a little more polished.[/p][p] [/p][p]Lastly, we have reached a new milestone: We surpassed 50k Wishlists, mainly due to a huge influx of Japanese players. It seems like a bunch of Japanese influencers discovered Gamblers Table and played it on their channels. Thank you all for playing and covering Gamblers Table and for wishlisting and for following the development![/p][p]私たちのコミュニティへようこそ[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45599374/5d021ca52754244644a119cfc8d34a20636afa5c.gif"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Rethinking UI in Gamblers Table
notes.notes: [p]Hey there![/p][p]As of until now, I was really displeased with the UI in Gamblers Table. Depending on what language you selected it could happen that text was not properly aligned, overflowed or was down-right impossible to read. Speaking of "impossible to read" - on small devices it was just that - impossible to read. Sadly, the engine I am working with has no native functionality to easily scale text at runtime across all UI components. But I was determined to make it happen nonetheless. [/p][p][/p][p]So lets dive right in.[/p][p][/p][h2]Accessibility[/h2][p]Keeping up the momentum from last update I've now worked on more accessibility features.[/p][p][/p][h3]Text Scaling[/h3][p]As I said in the beginning, reading the text on the steam deck, mobile or literally any screen that is not "Ultra-Wide-Super-Duper-Mega-Big-Screen"-size was kind of hard. The game now starts with bigger text to begin with and you also have an option to increase it. (or decrease it, if you liked the previous size more)[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45599374/d2b2d1c47d4722948d12970621099f81d7cd9344.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Button Size[/h3][p]Most the buttons in the game have now increased in size by approx. 150%. It was just honestly really hard to click them on smaller devices.[/p][p][/p][h3]Better Tabs[/h3][p]So if you watch the GIF above in "Text Scaling" you can see that the tabs in both the option menu and the shop jump into the next line. This was previously not the case. Instead the buttons would just disappear into the void and you had to click an extremely itsy bitsy small ">"-icon to navigate them.[/p][p]This was not an issue for western languages, but especially for languages with a lot of characters that easily surpassed the width of the sidebar itself.  This is now fixed.[/p][p][/p][h3]Better Explanations[/h3][p]We received feedback that its not super clear what Sacrificing even does - and some skills could do with better explanations.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45599374/66153deacddc1ad63cef6b7612bf721413cd1c29.png"][/img][/p][p]Sacrifing no longer requires you to hold the sacrifice button. Instead, a popup opens explaing what exactly is going to happen. Admittedly this does not look super fancy and requires more polish, but that is something for upcoming updates. Having UI elements that require you to hold them can be an issue for people with motor impairments, muscle weakness, tremors, joint pain, or certain neurological conditions that make sustained pressure hard.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45599374/f9f5194617454cdc4c088fbd3522aad7ce6f8ce6.png"][/img][/p][p]It wasn't quite clear what "Sticky" really does and it sounded stronger than it actually was. It now better reflects it actual functionality, as it only triggers on-click and not when a helper, reflip or shockwave flips it.[/p][p][/p][h3]There are upgrades?!?[/h3][p]You'd be surprised (or maybe not, surprise!) that a lot of players play the game for hours without ever buying a single upgrade. But not on purpse. Apparently it was that easy to miss ... I hope that the text scaling mitigates that issue at least a little. But to be very sure, the sidebar tabs now blink until you click them at least once.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45599374/d1895f3a03ff2613141b8f169fc5998c8d5f2e5a.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Speaking of blinking ...[/h3][p]We've had some feedback regarding the wishlist button in the game. It kept blinking ... and blinking. Which totally distracted a lot of you. Sorry about that.[/p][p]That wishlist button (as dumb as this may sound) is extremely important to us. Back when Gamblers Table was only available via Web it got stolen over and over again and being reuploaded to other pages and generated ad revenue for the thieves without us ever knowing.[/p][p]Having this wishlist button was our only saving grace, because no matter how often it got stolen - this button always brought anyone playing back to our steam page! And we could see that it worked.[/p][p]But having it blink all the time really is a tad excessive. So now it no longer does that and sits quietly and statically in the corner.[/p][p]For anyone wanting us to completely remove it:[/p][p]Sorry, but wishlists are super, duper important for small games like ours. Amount of wishlists is that magic number that steam uses to determine if you're in the charts or being sent to the shadow realm. The final release will of course not have it, but the demo will continue to feature the button. Thank you for understanding.[/p][p][/p][h2]UI Changes[/h2][p]You may have noticed that the sidebar looks a little different now. That is because it underwent some major changes. Lets take a look.[/p][p][/p][h3]Drag to arrange[/h3][p]We've gotten the feedback that some of you would like to see more of the shop, but also some of you wanted to see more of other things. You decide now! You can drag the separator in the sidebar to adjust how much of which you want to see.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45599374/25d41edb1ebed36afa70adfab3c883ae74804d7c.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Tactics[/h3][p]Looking at the GIF above, you can see that there is a new tab "Tactics". Before, the "Helper Focus" configuration was cramped into the lower sidebar window together with the buffs. The "Helper Focus" configuration has now moved into the "Tactics" tab instead.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45599374/2a7f3cacf30443753ee61a98c20df1982d68eb76.png"][/img][/p][p]There is also a new achievement for clicking that bad boy. As we have learned previously - not everyone clicks those! So wear that fish head with pride and joy.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45599374/4e0c0454b346129170918f25be4208e4feb7326c.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Shop Item Buttons[/h3][p]The buttons to buy weren't really great. They had their information really cramped and their text didn't break that well if it was too long. Now the amount you have is tidied up in the lower right corner.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45599374/2ed7221ac516e96aa5a57d0572382ac2c3263070.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Stats Tree[/h3][p]Okay, so this one is really cool. So many of you wanted a "X per second" display. Here it is! I've completly reworked the stats tab and will now show you the money generated by every coin split up into the sources. You also get a cool bar chart to see what performs the best out of the sources![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45599374/fc648115324b3a787209610cd770e0c98995135a.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Anyways ...[/h2][p]I could continue on and on about other smaller changes I did. Some wording here and there.[/p][p]But lets look at some stuff awaiting you in the final release! [/p][p][/p][p]Those are some of the new skills you will find in the skill tree of the release version. Would love your guesses on what you think what they do! My favorite is the helper on a rocket ... Wonder what that is about ...[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45599374/b2f8c52c66e79d43d4d8a7d1ef1d92c6937c8ec2.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]We regularly post images like that on our discord in the #progress-channel. Feel free to join![/p][p]I've made it my personal mission to greet each and every single one of you with a HI-reaction. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45599374/fcb999570c12743cc3770899f1f4d73ada2fda9b.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for playing![/p]

notes.title: Accessibility in Gamblers Table Demo
notes.notes:
[p]Hey there!
The demo seems to be doing well. Seeing your discord messages, mails, reviews, blog posts, videos ... it is super exciting and we could not be happier. We've just reached 40.000 wishlists! As a team of just two, we did not expect for things to go the way they're currently going. We both truly appreciate it, thank you.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45599374/a3c231fad07e4ccb6c6851e6ed0f26430986a51f.gif"][/img]

I've got some exciting new to share. Among some quality of life changes, bug fixes and performance improvements I've also worked on some other things that I'd love to share with you - so let's break it down.[/p][p][/p][h2]Accessibility[/h2][p]Gamblers Table initially only released as a prototype on itch.io back in march. It had no audio settings and the most received feedback was for a way to turn off the sound. Those are settings that normally get prioritized when developing games, so I immediately patched it in.[/p][p][/p][p]But among other feedback we've also gotten a lot of requests regarding the amount of clicking. While "Quick Flip" alleviated some issues, players that had genuine wrist problems would still struggle to play the game overall. But for obvious reasons we concentrated on working in more content first.

I myself also struggle with a pained wrist due to a sport incident, so it was a very dear topic to me that I want to eventually extend the options of Gamblers Table by a palette of accessibility options.[/p][p]So now I finally got around to add the first set of accessibility options for the game.[/p][p][/p][h3]Automatic clicking[/h3][p]You can toggle an option that automatically flips coins at your cursor every second. For some reason the image is way slower than what it actually looks like, but you get the idea.[/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45599374/0832fe5fb27c48c1a2c3c8a92d460178fcd64258.gif"][/img][/h3][h3]Cursor Size[/h3][p]In the midst of all the flashy effects (which is a topic for maybe another accessibility option) you sometimes lose track of your cursor. Being able to adjust the size is one of the options in the game.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45599374/9c6439b208fd994a85e9189cd261e51b202570a2.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45599374/1974f5da36dc3b9be7aab76f1e1e1b38abdd478e.png"][/img][/p][h3]Cursor Color[/h3][p]Following up on the previous point, you can now also adjust the color of your cursor. This also changes the color of the 1-second indicator of the auto-clicker option of you have that enabled.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45599374/93a94b63c88048cb67d9f25faa5b51a34204800b.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45599374/55872d5cb9e1ba730d3f7c8e92c6763ed855cf9a.png"][/img][/p][p]These are the first changes that made it into the demo and will also be present in the final release. But why stop there? As mentioned above, reducing the visual explosion fest that Gamblers Table naturally is should also be a toggle. I'd also love to add an option to increase the text size, but that is an issue that sadly needs a little more effort and will be included in future updates.[/p][p][/p][h2]Quality of Life[/h2][p]As a gamer, the annoying part of playing a demo, prototype or early access game is that often they are missing some key quality of life features that seasoned games already contain. That is just a natural, as the earlier game versions need to flesh out their content first - Gamblers Table not being an exception.[/p][p]But now that the demo has launched I was finally able to work in some of your suggestions (pst, join the discord!) and ideas[/p][p][/p][h3]Skill Tree meets Drag Movement[/h3][p]A lot of people were wondering why only the middle mouse button moves the skill tree. And that is a valid question - but no more! Both either holding left click or right click while dragging the mouse now moves the skill tree.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45599374/3d8d66bb20598163acbf3520342044d6121174c3.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]When are we there?[/h3][p]Gaining progress is good and all - but it would be nice what that progress even relates to. 50% of what? Meters? Kilos? Cheese? The skill tree button so far may have shown that you are half-way there toward your next skill tree point, but didn't give any further information. Now, hovering the skill tree button tells you how much of what. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45599374/5695e36657fb3d77a65f6db6ad1ccf648475ec9b.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]"I've played 23467829349878923 seconds!"[/h3][p]So ... divided by 60 ... is ... and then divided by 60 ... wait how much again? I had the bright idea that the playtime should be displayed as seconds. That just didn't make any sense at all. No further explanation needed, its now hours and minutes.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45599374/ec91a7f4846bb4ef147074b4ae149eb0adc75e09.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Upcoming[/h2][p]The demo also contains some hidden customization where you can overwrite the image of your cursor or the tablecloth in the middle, but I'll talk more about that when I've added the option to add your own hats into the game.[/p][p][/p][p]I'd also like to replace the money source information in the info tab with money/sec displays. So instead of accumulating the total value that a gold coin netted you it will instead show the money it netted you in the last X seconds. This should better indicate your progress and the speed at which things are going on.[/p][p][/p][p]There is just so much more to talk about it, but lets wrap it up for today and keep some for the next posts.
[/p][p]Thank your for playing Gamblers Table![/p]

notes.title: The Gamblers Table Demo is Out Now!
notes.notes:

notes.title: Demo release date, 30k club and new features
notes.notes: [p]Great news! We have been hard at work on the upcoming steam demo and it even has a release date! We will launch the demo next week on the [b]23rd of July[/b]![/p][p]If you have played the prototype version on itch you might wonder what is going to be different in the Steam Demo. We actually overhauled it quite a lot:[/p][list][*][p]The balancing has been dramatically improved[/p][/*][*][p]New prestige mechanic and a talent tree[/p][/*][*][p]9 unlockable talent points that have a significant impact on the gameplay[/p][/*][*][p]Achievements (only in-game, we will have proper Steam achievements in the full game)[/p][/*][*][p]New upgrades[/p][/*][*][p]New sprites, icons and animations[/p][/*][*][p]A bunch of crazy hats for the helpers[/p][/*][*][p]More languages! We support 15 languages now; this wouldn’t have been possible without the help of our amazing discord community, thank you all so much! If anyone finds an error in the localization, please let us know[/p][/*][*][p]Controller support[/p][/*][*][p]Steamdeck support[/p][/*][*][p]Twitch integration (You can have the helpers be named like people in your twitch chat and spout random chat messages)[/p][/*][*][p]Customizable table cloth[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Next some good news, that probably nobody besides us devs cares about haha: We made it to 30k Wishlists and are moving steadily towards 40k! Thank you all for following us and contributing so much to the development of the game! We are going to run out of coin rain GIFs soon :D[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45599374/16f5905677a6cab014787a08cab820693b5fc2f4.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]And finally, let me share some visuals of new features:[/p][p]As I mentioned above, you can now customize your table cloth, Greenpixels recorded a short video explaining the feature. We have already seen some really fun community designs in our discord![/p][previewyoutube="mVEvT6FFTxc;leftthumb"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]This is the first glimpse at the underlying lore of the game, it’s the animation that plays when players reset the game to start a new prestige run[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45599374/317bca44565794bef0342f5fe24c03e8856c7603.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]And here are two GIFs of upcoming mechanics (they are still “work in progress” and won’t be in the demo though), nothing out of the ordinary, just what you would expect from a game about flipping coins:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45599374/d9bbb357af13be51281435f1332698ce1886c7ed.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45599374/52a9c37d630d8cfcae2e0fcb43855b2fa2727699.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]And as always, if you want to particiapte in the development of Gamblers Table, join our discord and let us know your ideas or just hang out and chat with us: [url="https://discord.gg/qe5FZbpFAE" style="button"]Discord Link[/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Gamblers Table is coming to Steam!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

We are excited to announce that Gamblers Table will be coming to Steam!

First, let us give you a quick rundown of who we are and where the idea for Gamblers Table came from. We are Greenpixels and Bossforge, a team of two hobbyist indie devs from Germany. Earlier this year we wanted to work on just a small prototype together and set ourselves a deadline of 3 weeks. Since we are both fans of incremental games the choice of genre was easy and the idea for Gamblers Table was born.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45599374/14280bb7bafa58e1e4b9668f1e6e943020b78747.gif[/img]

About 6 weeks ago we published the “finished” prototype on itch.io. We didn’t expect more than a handful of players to try the game but then the game started trending and ended up on #1 of the New&Popular category with thousands of daily players. We have been absolutely overwhelmed by all the great feedback and ideas that we received from all of you, thank you all so much!
Due to the amazing reception, we are going to turn the prototype into a fully fleshed out Steam game now! Here is a quick rundown of what additional features and changes we have planned for the full version:

-	Significantly longer playtime
-	More coin types
-	Better income statistics
-	Coins that interact with the board in more interesting ways
-	Controlling in which direction a coin flies when flipping it
-	Controlling which types of coins the automation helpers will flip
-	In general, more interactions with the helpers
-	Customization for the helpers (hats)
-	Upgrades that change the table
-	Better sound effects
-	Ascencion/Prestige system
-	Talent tree
-	More clarity about when and how upgrades unlock
-	Achievements

Most of these additions come from player feedback. If you have any ideas or wishes for the full game, we would love to know! If you didn’t have a chance to play it, the prototype is still available on [url=https://greenpixels.itch.io/gamblers-table]itch.io[/url], go check it out and let us know what you think :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45599374/575aadc915de327bf3df0ec61a54af81168692c7.gif[/img]

So, whats next? We will be working on the full game and post regular updates here on the Steam community hub. There will also be a Steam demo with most of the final features closer to release. If you click the follow button, you’ll be notified whenever we post and when the demo goes live.
